text: Acceptance revalidated 2026-08-03: stable basis identities/roles, custom cardinality validation, typed coefficient-versus-response selection, response functional units/discretization, covariance and hypothesis transport, and OLS integration all have focused JVM+Scala.js evidence. Gates: BasisGeometrySuite 19/19 on JVM and JS; OlsSuite + StructuralHypothesisSuite 24/24 on JVM and JS. Broader external parity remains useful follow-on coverage but is not an unmet criterion of this issue.
